name: Low Ceiling
description: Buried vocals under three layers of guitar, the drums mixed low and far back. Builds for two minutes and never quite breaks.

name: Paper Street
description: Brighter than the rest of the record. Jangling open chords, a chorus that actually arrives.

name: Tide Clock
description: Voice and nylon-string guitar, recorded in one take with the window open. You can hear a car go past in the second verse.

name: Harrow Lane
description: A walking song in 6/8 about leaving somewhere small. Close-harmony vocals on the last chorus.

name: Radiator
description: Ninety seconds, one riff, no solo. Recorded loud and left that way.

name: Two Stops Early
description: Faster than Radiator and half as tidy. Shouted gang vocals on the chorus.

name: Sunday Market
description: Horn section over a shuffling two-bar groove. The bass carries the tune and the vocals sit on top of it.

name: Lagos at Six
description: Slower and dubbier. Long instrumental stretch in the middle where the horns drop out entirely.

name: Birch
description: Twelve minutes of processed piano and tape hiss. Nothing happens quickly and that is the point.

name: Frost on the Inside
description: Field recordings of a cold morning under a single sustained synth chord.

name: Signal Fade
description: Four-to-the-floor with a detuned lead that drifts sharp on purpose. Peaks late.

name: Night Bus
description: Downtempo, heavy on the low end, vocal sample chopped past recognition.

name: Cheap Seats
description: Live band, no click track, and a vocal take with an audible crack in the last chorus that they kept.

name: Tin Roof
description: Organ-led and slow. Closer to gospel than the rest of the record.

name: Eighth Avenue
description: Hard bop head, then four choruses of trading. Piano drops out for the bass solo.

name: Last Call
description: A ballad taken very slowly, brushes throughout, muted trumpet on the melody.

name: Glasshouse
description: Seven minutes with no vocals. Two guitars circling each other until the drums arrive at four.

name: Thirty Miles of Fence
description: Quieter and stranger. Bowed guitar and a drum part that never settles into a backbeat.

name: Two Cigarettes
description: Pedal steel, brushed snare, and a lyric that does not resolve. Three verses, no bridge.

name: County Line
description: Up-tempo and cheerful about something fairly bleak. Fiddle takes the solo.
